stories.headline: Pope Leo XIV appeals for release of Haiti hostages, prays for flood victims in Nepal and Tibet
stories.summary: During his address, Pope Leo XIV directed the global church's care toward suffering communities, calling for the liberation of captives held in Haiti and offering petitions for those affected by severe flooding across Nepal and Tibet. He encouraged the faithful to bring their candid struggles and uncertainties before the Lord, while continuing to submit gently to divine wisdom.
